name: propose_storyboard

input.title: NOVA logo reveal
input.style: Calm geometric fintech: Sine/Quart eases, no overshoot on the mark, one accent
input.styleReason: A small fintech needs trust and precision: slow, exact geometry and a single accent read as credible rather than flashy.

concepts.name: Cut
concepts.idea: The ring draws itself on, then a diagonal slash strikes through it as the circle closes, so the mark is made by one decisive cut.
concepts.why: Money is cut clean: the slash reads as precision and a decision, matching a simple-finance promise.

concepts.name: Assemble
concepts.idea: The circle and the slash arrive from opposite sides and lock together with a short snap at the crossing point.
concepts.why: Reads as parts coming together into one trusted system; clear but more generic.

concepts.name: Ignite
concepts.idea: The ring draws on, and a small accent dot at its top flares once and settles, like a nova igniting.
concepts.why: Ties the name to a star, but the flare can read as a notification badge.

beats.name: Mark draws
beats.description: Thin navy-on-off-white ring draws on from 0.1 s (Sine In Out, 0.8 s). The accent slash strikes through the ring as it closes (starts ~0.75 s, Expo Out, 0.45 s), and the crossing forms the mark.

beats.name: Wordmark slides out
beats.description: NOVA slides out from behind the mark's right edge, clipped by the mark so it emerges rather than fading over it. Quart Out, 0.9 s, wide tracking.

beats.name: Tagline
beats.description: "Money, made simple" fades in and rises 12 px beneath the wordmark, muted grey-blue. Sine Out, 0.6 s.

beats.name: Hold
beats.description: Full lockup holds still for about 1.2 s, the ending is a clean frame with no motion.

input.notes: Palette: navy background #0B1A33, off-white #F4F6FA for the ring and wordmark, muted #8FA3BF for the tagline, one accent #3DDC97 (mint) on the slash only. Type: sans, wordmark weight 600–700, tagline 500. Layout: the mark and wordmark sit centred as one lockup in the 1920x1080 frame, all inside title-safe. Open question: confirm the concept (Cut recommended) and accent color; I will build the chosen one.
